findings.title: `stash eql upgrade --eql-version 3` drops every customer column typed with an eql_v3 domain
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified: the v3 supabase bundle drops eql_v3 CASCADE, domains are defined there at line 545, and upgrade re-runs it with no dependent-column guard.

findings.title: v3 Supabase filters send a decryptable ciphertext plus all index terms in PostgREST GET URLs
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same verified full-envelope operand in GET URLs from encryptCollectedTerms, acknowledged in the class doc.

findings.title: v3 `like`/`ilike` silently return no rows for default-configured text_search columns
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The v3 TextSearch default include_original:true with the cs remap silently fails substring matches; the live test has to opt out explicitly.
